hints.title: Examine Individual Digits
hints.text: Each deci-binary number contributes at most 1 to any decimal digit position.

hints.title: Maximum Digit Bound
hints.text: To form a digit d in string n, you need at least d deci-binary numbers that have 1 in that position.

hints.title: Answer Equals Maximum Digit
hints.text: The answer is simply the maximum numeric digit present in string n.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: L is length of string n
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying to greedily construct the deci-binary strings is unnecessary when only the count is needed.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single pass to find the maximum character digit takes O(L) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate explains why the maximum digit is both a lower bound and achievable.
